data.one_liner: A customizable searchable dropdown widget for single or multi-select.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dropdown that lets users search through a dynamic list. Supports single and multi-select modes, custom labels, icons, and optional widget rendering of selected values.
use_when: Need a searchable dropdown in a form
Require simple integration without extra dependencies
avoid_when: Building a complex form with many custom validation rules
Needing advanced state management beyond a simple widget
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import the package
